name: navbea-rvm
description: GPL-3.0 local Robust Video Matting service and diagnostics application

scripts.service:dev: cross-env NAVBEA_RVM_DEV=1 NAVBEA_RVM_FIXTURE=1 NAVBEA_RUNTIME_DIR=.runtime/run NAVBEA_CAMERA_DATA_DIR=.runtime/camera-data NAVBEA_RVM_DATA_DIR=.runtime/data NAVBEA_CAMERA_CLIENT_TOKEN=development-camera-token-000000000000000000000000 node service/main.cjs
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k "vite --port 4176 --strictPort" "npm run service:dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:4176 && cross-env NAVBEA_RVM_DEV=1 NAVBEA_RUNTIME_DIR=.runtime/run NAVBEA_RVM_DATA_DIR=.runtime/data VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4176 electron-forge start"
